description: Extend existing Channels.Web.Runtime build(config,hooks) without changing global Bridge callbacks; introduce widget-specific behaviour build/2 and embed_script/2. Contract: trusted server module only; snippet returns bounded text/error, never execute in BO, no secrets. Move stylesheet from persisted WidgetSettings/runtime hooks into Command conversation_init params; absolute HTTP(S) only, optional, no credentials or other schemes, no fetching/proxy/persistence. Local-only pure transport validation and lifecycle callback: no standalone executable Action needed. Tests first: command validation/property coverage, ingress manual-struct revalidation, runtime builder compatibility and snippet failure contracts. Preserve existing BO contracts and lazy widget init.
title: [zaq-pkd.16] Adapter contract and init-only remote stylesheet
